label: NUP98::TOP1

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
TOP1 encodes DNA topoisomerase I, which relieves DNA torsional stress.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The TOP1 partner contributes carboxy-terminal topoisomerase sequences; it is a rare recurrent NUP98 partner in AML.
